description: A migrated .NET MAUI Windows project with native WinUI XAML fails with CS5001/no AppxManifest when default MAUI items are disabled without the corresponding WinUI item setup, based on https://github.com/dotnet/maui/issues/21559.
prompt: I'm adding our old UWP/WinUI views into a .NET MAUI Windows target. The only way I got past XAML errors was disabling default MAUI items, but now Windows either says `Program does not contain a static 'Main' method suitable for an entry point` or `no AppxManifest is specified`; should I add my own `Main` method?
